title: Feral (bear) druid: bashes a casting mob within 3 s of the cast start

rules.desc: The bear casts Bash on the mob within 3 s of an interruptible cast start, at least 60 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 10 s, one counted answer per 60 s: Bash has a 60 s cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:388-395 (tank cc: bash and bash on enemy healer at ACTION_INTERRUPT); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:149-153 (BashInterruptSpellTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the stun answers the cast but its 60 s cooldown means the bear can only catch about one cast a minute; whether most triggers get an answer is the question. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: the bear holds Bear Form or Dire Bear Form (aura 5487 or 9634) for at least 90 percent of its in-combat samples, so the bashes come from a tank in form
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:273-276 (bear form -> dire bear form at ACTION_MOVE + 9); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:207-212 (BearFormTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the buff row re-shifts the bear on the next tick whenever the form drops (the tank-bear-growl-maul trial); without form the interrupt numbers mean nothing. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
